nodes.name: Get permission to cut down a tree on your plot
nodes.description: A synthetic service used to demonstrate the pipeline end to end. Nothing here describes a real government process.

metadata.timeline: 15 working days from a complete application
metadata.whatToDo: Apply on the Example Services Portal, attach this year's property tax receipt, and pay 200 rupees per tree.

sources.evidence: Any owner of a plot inside the corporation limits may apply to fell a tree standing on that plot.

nodes.name: Property tax receipt for the current year

sources.evidence: The applicant must attach a copy of the property tax receipt for the current year.

nodes.name: Pay the tree felling permit fee

metadata.fee: 200 rupees per tree, paid online with the application

sources.evidence: The fee is 200 rupees per tree, payable online at the time of application.
Applications are accepted only through the Example Services Portal.

nodes.name: You must be 18 or older
nodes.description: The applicant must have completed 18 years of age on the date of application.

sources.evidence: The applicant must have completed 18 years of age on the date of application.

nodes.name: Proof that the plot is yours
nodes.description: Either document is accepted on its own. The page does not prefer one.

sources.evidence: Ownership of the plot may be proved with either the registered sale deed or the current municipal property card. Enclose whichever one you hold.
